description: Read a repository on OpenVibe.Git (git.openvibe.codes): its row, tree, blob, raw file, commits, one commit with its diff, branches, tags, releases, contributors and insights. A public repository is read without a token. A private one needs its owner's session, a Git token made on the repository page, or a first-party service token (Codes, Run, Link) that holds this capability for the audience openvibe.git and names the person in X-OV-Subject. A private repository answers 404 to anyone who may not see it, never 403.
